subject: Confirm DetectionEvent window stats and SignalFrame rate
body: D-contracts-004 proposes SignalFrame {t epoch ms, source, hr, rr[], quality, scenarioStep?}, Calibration {stats hrMean, hrSd, rmssd, sdnn?}, and DetectionEvent {window {seconds, hrMean, rmssd, hrDelta, rmssdDelta, z}, gate {consecutiveWindows, required, refractorySeconds, sham}}. I need one thing: the window stats and gate fields your detector will actually emit, plus your frame rate. I'll give you frames.drift.json (baseline -> drift -> recovery) and detection fixtures at M1.
